requirement: Implement v1.3 EPIC 3 Story 1: prevent sticky touch hover states by gating every CSS hover rule behind @media (hover: hover).

architecture.decision: Use CSS @media (hover: hover) wrappers while keeping focus-visible and active feedback unguarded.
tradeoffs: CSS media queries solve the platform-level cause without changing interaction code.
seams: Existing component CSS files own their local hover rules.
